external_entities.name: colleagues
external_entities.description: People who sign in through the identity broker and use applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
external_entities.notes: Whether colleagues are asked for a second factor is not documented.

external_entities.name: franchise colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues from franchise stores who authenticate through their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: It is not documented which colleagues the franchise identity provider is allowed to vouch for.

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: The franchise's own identity provider that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, maintains directory membership, and writes sign-ins to an audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The broker's interface kind, exposure, directory encryption, audit-log encryption, and second-factor use are not documented.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that allows holders of a token containing the store-manager group to change prices and void transactions for every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to.

processes.name: application
processes.description: An application that takes the broker-issued token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
processes.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
processes.notes: The description does not identify a particular application beyond the store admin console.

processes.name: HR system
processes.description: The system from which colleague group membership and leaver changes are pulled overnight.
processes.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the broker for tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_stores.notes: Whether the key store is encrypted at rest is not documented.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The broker's directory containing colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: Whether the directory is encrypted where it sits is not documented.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. Whether it is encrypted where it sits is not documented.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: Colleagues sign in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.
data_flows.notes: Whether colleagues are asked for a second factor is not documented.
data_flows.data_description: Colleague sign-in information.

data_flows.name: vouch
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for franchise colleagues.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them
data_flows.notes: It is not documented which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.
data_flows.data_description: Franchise colleague identity and sign-in information.

data_flows.name: federated sign-in
data_flows.description: The identity broker accepts the franchise identity provider's vouching as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: It is not documented which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.
data_flows.data_description: Franchise colleague identity and sign-in assertion.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a signed-in colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing the colleague's staff id and group membership.

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: A colleague presents the broker-issued token to an application.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership.

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: A colleague presents the broker-issued token to the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.notes: The console uses the store-manager group but does not check which store the colleague belongs to.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership.

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: Applications fetch the public half of the broker's signing key to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the token-signing key.

data_flows.name: use signing key
data_flows.description: The broker uses the signing key kept in the key store to sign tokens.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_flows.notes: The same key signs tokens for every application.
data_flows.data_description: Token-signing key.

data_flows.name: pull membership
data_flows.description: The broker pulls colleague group-membership and leaver changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.notes: The changes include group membership and the removal of leavers as colleagues.
data_flows.data_description: Colleague accounts, group membership, and leaver changes.

data_flows.name: maintain directory
data_flows.description: The broker maintains its directory of colleagues and their groups.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_flows.notes: Group membership comes from the HR system overnight and is not maintained there by hand.
data_flows.data_description: Colleague records and group membership.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in events.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: Colleagues' own devices at home from which they sign in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-controlled environment associated with franchise colleagues and their own identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's contents are confidential because they include colleague records and group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The directory contains colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The signing key store's contents are confidential because it holds a token-signing secret.
assumptions.basis: The key store holds the signing key used to sign tokens.
